correctness.rationale: R_n=tr(A^n) for the x^3-x-1 companion matrix. Exact modular matrix identities show that each of 22 index branches is a restricted analytic quadratic perturbation with unit quadratic coefficient. Hensel critical points and a square-root isometry give precisely quadratic 23-adic images. An exhaustive 22-by-23 finite certificate establishes 198 noncritical residue balls and 13 uniquely represented critical classes modulo 529. Their full lifts and square lifts yield the theorem for all k, and a separate derivative argument establishes the least period. The standalone verifier checks all finite premises and directly enumerates k=1..4; finite data are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Prime 23 is the unique ramified prime of the classical Perrin characteristic cubic (discriminant -23), providing intrinsic motivation for this local invariant. The result determines all 23-power value-set sizes, an exact 23-adic Haar measure, and separates 198 regular residue balls from 13 quadratic critical branches. It is a structural infinite-level classification, not an arbitrary small-modulus census.
